a stable relationship: After years of dating different people, Mark finally found a stable relationship with someone who shares his values.
和不同的人約會多年之後，馬克終於和一位與他價值觀相同的人建立了穩定的關係。
a stable job: My parents hope I will find a stable job after college instead of moving from one short-term position to another.
我父母希望我大學畢業後能找到一份穩定的工作，而不是在短期職位之間換來換去。
in stable condition: The driver was badly hurt in the accident, but doctors say he is now in stable condition at the hospital.
那名駕駛在車禍中受了重傷，但醫生說他目前在醫院裡病情穩定。
a stable economy: Foreign companies are more willing to invest in a country with a stable economy and low unemployment.
外國企業比較願意投資經濟穩定、失業率低的國家。
emotionally stable: Nurses need to stay emotionally stable and calm, even when patients and their families are angry or upset.
護理師必須保持情緒穩定與冷靜，即使病人和家屬生氣或沮喪也一樣。
a stable government: Without a stable government, the country changed leaders three times in one year, and people lost trust in politics.
由於缺乏穩定的政府，這個國家一年內換了三次領導人，人民對政治失去了信任。
stale bread: The bread was left out on the table for three days, so we fed the stale bread to the ducks.
麵包在桌上放了三天，所以我們把那些不新鮮的麵包拿去餵鴨子。
stale news: By the time my uncle told us about the singer's wedding, it was stale news; we had read it online last week.
等到我叔叔告訴我們那位歌手結婚的事時，那已經是過時的消息了；我們上週就在網路上看過了。
a stale joke: Grandpa told a stale joke that we had heard a hundred times, but we still smiled to be polite.
爺爺講了一個我們聽過上百遍的老掉牙笑話，但我們還是禮貌地笑了笑。
stale air: The classroom had been closed all weekend, so we opened the windows to let out the stale air.
教室整個週末都關著，所以我們打開窗戶讓不流通的空氣散出去。
go stale: If a TV show repeats the same kind of story every week, it will quickly go stale and lose viewers.
如果一個電視節目每週都重複同一種故事，很快就會變得乏味並失去觀眾。
a stale relationship: After ten years of the same routine, they felt they were in a stale relationship and decided to travel together more.
十年來一成不變的生活後，他們覺得彼此的關係變淡了，於是決定多一起去旅行。
a steady job: After graduating, Kevin got a steady job at a bank, so he no longer worries about paying his rent.
畢業後，凱文在銀行找到一份穩定的工作，所以他不再擔心付不出房租。
a steady income: Renting out the extra apartment gives my aunt a steady income every month, even after she retires.
出租多出來的公寓讓我阿姨每個月都有穩定的收入，即使退休後也一樣。
a steady pace: Marathon runners should keep a steady pace instead of running too fast at the beginning of the race.
馬拉松跑者應該保持穩定的步調，而不是在比賽一開始就跑得太快。
a steady hand: Painting tiny details on the model ship requires patience and a steady hand that does not shake at all.
在模型船上畫細小的細節需要耐心，以及一雙完全不會抖的穩健的手。
a steady boyfriend: Amy has had a steady boyfriend for two years, and her parents have already met his family.
艾咪有一個交往兩年的固定男友，她父母也已經見過他的家人了。
steady progress: Although his English is not perfect yet, Tom has made steady progress by practicing a little every day.
雖然湯姆的英文還不完美，但他靠著每天練習一點，取得了穩定的進步。
slow and steady: You don't need to finish the whole book this week; slow and steady is the best way to learn a language.
你不需要這週就讀完整本書；穩紮穩打才是學語言最好的方法。
hold steady: Oil prices are expected to hold steady this month, so the cost of gas should not change much.
預計本月油價將保持穩定，所以汽油費用應該不會有太大變化。
a steep rise in prices: After the typhoon destroyed many farms, there was a steep rise in prices for vegetables at the market.
颱風摧毀了許多農田之後，市場上的蔬菜物價急遽上漲。
a steep decline: Since the factory closed, the town has seen a steep decline in population as young people move away.
自從工廠關閉後，隨著年輕人外移，這個小鎮的人口急遽下降。
a steep learning curve: Starting a job at a tech company was a steep learning curve for me, since I had never written code before.
在科技公司開始工作對我來說是一條陡峭的學習曲線，因為我以前從沒寫過程式。
steep prices: The restaurant has a great view, but its steep prices mean most students can only eat there on special occasions.
這家餐廳景色很好，但價格過高，大多數學生只有在特殊場合才去得起。
a sticky situation: When Jenny accidentally invited both of her ex-boyfriends to the party, she found herself in a sticky situation.
珍妮不小心同時邀請了兩個前男友來參加派對，讓自己陷入了棘手的處境。
a sticky problem: Deciding which club members could go on the trip with only ten seats was a sticky problem for our leader.
只有十個座位，要決定哪些社員能去旅行，對我們社長來說是個難題。
sticky fingers: The shop owner suspected the new cashier had sticky fingers because money kept disappearing from the register.
店主懷疑新來的收銀員手腳不乾淨，因為收銀機裡的錢一直不見。
a sticky note: I left a sticky note on the fridge to remind my brother to take out the trash before dinner.
我在冰箱上貼了一張便利貼，提醒我弟弟晚餐前把垃圾拿出去倒。
come to a sticky end: In the old story, the greedy king who cheated his people would come to a sticky end in the final chapter.
在那個古老的故事裡，欺騙人民的貪婪國王在最後一章落得悲慘下場。
hot and sticky: Summer afternoons in Taipei are so hot and sticky that my shirt is wet after walking just five minutes.
台北的夏日午後又熱又黏，我才走五分鐘襯衫就濕透了。
